problem.listUnknown.message: "{list}" isn't a list of this workspace.
problem.listUnknown.note: list: the list ID an integration sent

problem.listOutOfScope.message: This key is limited to other lists than {list}.

problem.leftList.message: {email} left {list} {when, select, earlier {earlier} other {on {at, date}}}. ReputeCast doesn't add people back to a list they left.
problem.leftList.note: when: earlier when the day isn't known; at: the day they left, in the workspace's time zone

problem.suppressed.message: {email} is on the suppression list since {at, date} ({reason, select, hard_bounce {hard bounce} complaint {spam complaint} unsubscribe {unsubscribed from everything} manual {added by your team} imported {imported from a provider} role {role address} spam_trap {spam trap} invalid {invalid address} other {{reasonText}}}). ReputeCast doesn't add suppressed addresses.
problem.suppressed.note: at: the day it was suppressed; reason: why the address is suppressed; reasonText: an unknown reason as stored

problem.notEmail.message: That isn't an email address ({problem, select, noDomain {no domain} doubleDot {double dot} tooLong {too long} other {not an address}}).
problem.notEmail.note: problem: what is wrong with the address

problem.noContact.message: No contact with {email} in this workspace. Use “Create or update a contact” to add them.
problem.noContact.note: “Create or update a contact” is the action's name: item.upsert_contact

problem.fieldUnknown.message: {field} isn't a custom field. Create it first under Audience › Fields.
problem.fieldUnknown.note: field: the custom field's key, as sent (plan)

problem.fieldNumber.message: {field} is a number field; "{value}" isn't a number.
problem.fieldNumber.note: field: the custom field's key; value: what was sent

problem.fieldDate: {field} is a date field; use a date like 2026-10-30.
problem.fieldBoolean: {field} is a yes/no field; use true or false.

problem.fieldSelect.note: options: the field's choices, comma-separated, as the workspace wrote them

problem.cantDo.note: name: Zapier, Make, n8n or WordPress; item: the key that was sent (upsert_contact)

problem.cantGrant.message: You can't grant {permission} because you don't hold it.
problem.cantGrant.note: permission: a permission key such as transactional:send, never translated

problem.cantGrantAsk.message: You can't grant {permission} because you don't hold it. Ask {helpers}.
problem.cantGrantAsk.note: helpers: names joined as 'A, B or C'

problem.turnOnOne.message: Turn on at least one thing {name} can do.
problem.turnOnOne.note: name: Zapier, Make, n8n or WordPress

problem.siteAddress: Enter the site's address, like blog.acme.io.

problem.unreachable.message: {name} can't reach {url}, your public URL. Give the instance a public address (Instance admin › Instance & updates), or use n8n on your own network.
problem.unreachable.note: name: Zapier or Make; url: the instance's public URL

problem.alreadyConnected.message: {name} is already connected ({label}). Change what it can do, rotate its key, or disconnect it first.

problem.alreadyConnectedLabel.message: {label} is already connected. Open it to change what it can do.
problem.alreadyConnectedLabel.note: label: the connection's label, or a WordPress site's address

problem.expiryPast: Pick an expiry date in the future.
problem.scopeEscalation: A key can't reach lists outside your own scope.

problem.keyRevoked.message: {name}'s key was revoked. Reconnect to get a new one.
problem.keyRevoked.note: name: Zapier, Make, n8n or WordPress

problem.cantHandOut.message: You can't {verb, select, rotate {rotate} other {reconnect}} this key: it holds {permission}, which you don't hold.
problem.cantHandOut.note: permission: a permission key, never translated

problem.cantHandOutAsk.message: You can't {verb, select, rotate {rotate} other {reconnect}} this key: it holds {permission}, which you don't hold. Ask {helpers}.
problem.cantHandOutAsk.note: helpers: names joined as 'A, B or C'

problem.noOldKey: No old key is still working.
problem.keyStillWorks: {name}'s key still works. Rotate it to get a new one.
problem.nothingToTakeOver: {name} has no key to take over. Reconnect it instead.
problem.integrationOnly: Only an integration's key subscribes to triggers. For your own endpoints, use Settings › Webhooks or the webhooks API.

problem.noTrigger.note: event: the event that was sent (contact.subscribed)

problem.triggerOff.message: {name} can't use the {trigger} trigger: it was turned off. Change what {name} can do in Settings › Integrations.
problem.triggerOff.note: trigger: the trigger's name, item.<key> (Contact unsubscribed)

problem.privateAddress.message: {why, select, local {{host} is a local hostname} resolves {{host} resolves to {address}, a private address} other {{address} is a private or loopback address}}. Webhooks to private addresses stay blocked until an instance admin allows them (webhooks.allow_private_networks).{ask, select, yes { Ask {admins}.} other {}}
problem.privateAddress.note: why: why the address is private; admins: the instance admins' names joined as 'A, B or C'; webhooks.allow_private_networks is a setting, never translated

problem.fullURL: Use a full URL, like https://api.example.com/hooks/reputecast.
problem.credentialsInURL: Put credentials in the signing secret, not in the URL.

problem.blockedAddress.message: Address not allowed: {address} is a link-local, metadata or multicast address.

problem.siteOnly: Only a WordPress site's key calls this.
problem.siteURL: Send the site's address, like https://blog.acme.io.

problem.siteElsewhere.message: {site} is connected to {workspace}. A site connects to one workspace: disconnect it there first.
problem.siteElsewhere.note: site: blog.acme.io; workspace: another workspace's name

problem.draftExists: This post already has a draft.
problem.pickAudience: Pick the audience of the drafts.
problem.pickSender: Pick a sender of this workspace.
problem.pickMember: Pick a member of this workspace.

check.noPublicURL.note: a line of the public URL check, in the connect dialog

check.privateAddress.note: address: an IP address or a host name

check.timeout.note: Check now on a WordPress site; seconds: 10

check.status.note: status: 503; statusText: the HTTP reason, never translated (Service Unavailable)

label.formerMember.note: who connected an integration or owns its key, when they are no longer in the workspace

label.erasedContact.note: replaces an erased contact's address in the call log

label.aContact.note: replaces an address in the call log for members who can't see contacts

notify.keyRevoked.message: {name}: its key was revoked, so its calls are rejected. Reconnect to give it a new key.
notify.keyRevoked.note: name: Zapier, Make, n8n or WordPress

notify.keyExpired.message: {name}: its key expired on {at, date} {at, time}, so its calls are rejected. Reconnect to give it a new key.
notify.keyExpired.note: at: when, in the workspace's time zone

notify.ownerLeft.message: {name}: {owner}, who owns its key, left the workspace. Take it over to keep {name} running; the key stays the same.

notify.keyExpiring: {name}: its key expires on {at, date} {at, time}. Reconnect before then, or calls will be rejected.

notify.deliveriesFailing.message: {name}: deliveries to {host} have failed since {at, date} {at, time} ({status} {statusText}). They're retried for 6 hours.
notify.deliveriesFailing.note: host: n8n.acme.io; status: 503; statusText: the HTTP reason, never translated

notify.callsFailing: {name}: {failed, number} of its {calls, plural, one {# call} other {# calls}} in the last hour failed. Open it to see the errors and what to change.

notify.siteSilent.message: WordPress: {host} hasn't reported in since {at, date} {at, time}. Check the site, or disconnect it if it's gone.

notify.draftTitle.note: a notification's title: a WordPress post became a campaign draft

notify.draftBody.message: “{title}” from {site} is a draft for {list}. Review it, then send it through Send Readiness as usual.
notify.draftBody.note: title: the post's title; site: blog.acme.io; list: the draft's first list

notify.draftBodyNoList: “{title}” from {site} is a draft for its audience. Review it, then send it through Send Readiness as usual.

item.contact.subscribed.note: the triggers and actions of Zapier, Make and n8n, as the app names them
